A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same task-gram and distributional memorization study. The complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original task-performance measurements, distributional correlations, training-influence estimates, prompt-optimization results, and appendix sensitivity analyses and examples.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical analyses and expands the prompt-optimization results to additional base and instruction-tuned models.

M1.justification: The task-gram construction, distributional memorization measure, gradient-based influence procedure, and GPT4o prompt optimizer are unchanged. Dolma-specific optimized prompts apply the existing procedure rather than introduce a new method.

E1.justification: Both versions cover WMT-09, TriviaQA, MMLU, and GSM8K, with Pile, Dolma, and Europarl already represented. The expanded prompt experiment changes model configurations within existing task coverage.

E2.justification: The comparison methods remain task-gram versus infinity-gram, paired versus output-only document retrieval, and memorization- versus generalization-oriented prompting. Additional Table 1 models are evaluation targets, not new competing methods.

E3.justification: Section 7 expands beyond Pythia-12B to Pythia-6.9B, Pythia-Instruct-6.9B, OLMo-7B, and OLMo-instruct-7B, with Dolma-specific prompts documented in Appendix E. These additional settings are confined to the existing prompt-optimization experiment; the main evaluation protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The prompt-optimization case study now checks the task-dependent preference for frequent versus rare prompts across additional base and instruction-tuned models. The threshold-sensitivity analysis, training-influence analysis, qualitative examples, and generation-alignment analysis are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains the same p-value significance reporting. The expanded prompt experiment adds no repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds four model rows. For Pythia-12B, reported GSM8K memorization/generalization accuracies change from 3.9%/4.5% to 2.7%/2.8%, without an explanation; TriviaQA remains 28.7%/23.2%. The added rows preserve the task-specific prompt preference, and Table 2 adds Dolma prompt counts. Main plotted results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Definitions 1–3, the probability and correlation equations, and the training-influence formulas are unchanged. Equation relocation and tightened explanatory wording introduce no new mathematical reasoning or assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about task-gram modeling, stronger memorization in factual tasks, and greater generalization in harder reasoning tasks. The expanded experiment supports an existing practical claim.

C2.justification: The explanations involving translation transfer, factual recall, rare knowledge, reasoning, and training influence remain substantively unchanged. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning models, corpus search, and n-gram filtering.

D1.justification: v5 adds a code-access link, discloses that GSM8K task-gram pairs were mined from the 1K test set, and supplies Dolma-specific optimized prompts and counts. The mining statement documents an existing experiment rather than establishes changed data selection. A stale future-code-release footnote remains.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and substantive positioning against prior memorization studies and corpus-analysis methods are unchanged, including the expanded related-work discussion in Appendix C.

P1.justification: v5 makes limited wording and grammar edits, adjusts footnotes, and replaces the preprint header with the ICLR 2025 publication header. The title, narrative, section order, and appendix organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 becomes a full-width, five-model comparison instead of a small table wrapped within the text. Table 2 adds corpus grouping and Dolma rows. Text and equations reflow, while all twelve figures retain their content.

improvement.justification: The broader prompt-optimization evaluation and added code-access, GSM8K mining, and Dolma-prompt documentation modestly strengthen practical evidence and reproducibility. The core study is unchanged. Unexplained Pythia-12B GSM8K score revisions and continued absence of uncertainty reporting for this experiment limit the improvement.
